items.name: Classic Chicken Caesar Salad
items.description: Grilled chicken steak, hard-boiled eggs, crisp lettuce, cherry tomatoes, shaved parmesan and crunchy garlic croutons tossed in a signature Caesar dressing.

items.name: Asian Noodle Salad
items.description: Rice noodles, shredded purple cabbage, carrots, sliced onions, crunchy peanuts, fresh mint and coriander in a toasted sesame-soy vinaigrette.

items.name: Desi Mango & Sprout Salad
items.description: Protein-packed chana and moong sprouts tossed with fresh mango, cucumber, tomatoes, chaat masala and a sweet-spicy mango-jalapeño dressing.

items.name: Salad Caprese
items.description: Fresh buffalo mozzarella, ripe tomatoes, peppery arugula and basil, drizzled with walnut-basil pesto, balsamic glaze and toasted nuts.

items.name: Greek Hummus Salad
items.description: Creamy house-made hummus topped with crunchy cucumber, lettuce, cherry tomatoes, olives, onion, pomegranate and mint, dusted with za’atar and sumac, finished with sesame oil and crisp lavash.

items.name: Roasted Potato & Apple Salad
items.description: Herb-roasted potatoes, crisp apples, lettuce, cherry tomatoes and walnuts folded in a tangy French egg gribiche sauce with capers and gherkins.

items.name: Roasted Potato & Apple Salad (Eggless)
items.description: Herb-roasted potatoes, crisp apples, lettuce, cherry tomatoes and walnuts with a tangy eggless gribiche made on creamy hung curd, with gherkins and herbs.

items.name: Dark Chocolate Fruit Bowl
items.description: Velvety hung curd blended with dark chocolate compound, cocoa, orange zest and honey, topped with seasonal exotic fruits and granola or nuts.
